representation.input: the canonical DoclingDocument JSON persisted by parsing for the source's current parse_key (S3 artifact verified by size and SHA-256)
representation.markdown_input: forbidden; Markdown is never an intermediate representation for chunking
representation.format_neutral: PDF, HWP and HWPX artifacts go through the same chunking path; chunking never re-parses or branches on the source format
representation.output: FinalChunk collection consumed by the embedding stage

chunker.implementation: docling-core HybridChunker (no own structure-aware chunker, no semantic chunking)

serializer.reason: item meta (bizaid__* provenance) must never enter chunk or embedding text; provenance travels as FinalChunk metadata

chunker.embedding_text: announcement title (support_programs.name via the chunk's pblanc_id relation) on the first line when present, then HybridChunker.contextualize(chunk): heading path lines followed by the chunk text; the title is retrieval context only and chunk text stays the original body
chunker.size_rule: max_tokens is the HybridChunker target counted with the embedding tokenizer on the contextualized chunk; the title prefix is added after splitting, so embedding_text may exceed max_tokens by the title length (flagged by exceeds_max_tokens, never truncated; the embedding limit is 8192); a table row that HybridChunker cannot split may also exceed it
chunker.heading_rule: heading_path comes only from the parser's DoclingDocument headings; chunking does not infer headings
chunker.table_rule: TABLE_VALID TableItems are chunked by HybridChunker's table handling; TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED regions are parser text items and are chunked as ordinary text
chunker.heading_only_rule: always_emit_headings keeps headings whose section has no body; such a chunk has text = heading path and heading_only=true

tokenizer.location: dependencies.docling.model_artifacts in document-parsing.contract.json under BIZAID_DOCLING_ARTIFACTS_PATH; offline only, never downloaded at runtime
tokenizer.embedding_alignment: the chunker tokenizer and the embedding model are the same repo and revision; changing either changes the chunk identity

identity.chunk_set_key: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON of chunk_set_key_inputs
identity.chunking_config_sha256: SHA-256 of the chunker section of this contract plus the tokenizer repo and revision
identity.content_key: SHA-256 of chunk_set_key, chunk_index and announcement title; equal for announcements that share the source and the title, so their vector is embedded once
identity.chunk_id: UUIDv5 (namespace in chunking code) of chunk_set_key, pblanc_id and chunk_index; a valid Qdrant point id
identity.rule: same source, same parser result and same chunker configuration give the same chunk ids; any change to tokenizer, max_tokens, chunking policy or embedding_text context (chunker_version / chunker section) yields a new chunk_set_key before re-indexing

relations.unit: one FinalChunk per (announcement relation, chunk); a source attached to several announcements yields the same content_key under each pblanc_id
relations.pblanc_id: required on every FinalChunk; it is the MySQL-to-Qdrant join key
relations.title: support_programs.name of the pblanc_id

provenance.item: each DocItem of the chunk contributes item_ref, label, page and top-left bbox when the parser gave a ProvenanceItem, and HWPX section and XML path, table quality verdict and OCR confidence from bizaid__* meta
provenance.multi_location: provenance is a list and pages is the sorted set of pages, so a chunk spanning several pages or sections keeps every location
provenance.no_location: HWPX has no page or coordinates; pages stay empty and section / XML path identify the source location
provenance.image_ocr: IMAGE_OCR: page is the tile number, every page is the full original image size, so bbox_pt holds original image pixels (unit px); OCR confidence comes from bizaid__ocr

embedding_handoff.payload: every FinalChunk field except embedding_text may be stored as vector payload
embedding_handoff.not_in_scope: dense and sparse vector generation and Qdrant upsert belong to the embedding / indexing stage
embedding_handoff.alignment_rule: model_repo_id and model_revision must equal tokenizer.repo_id and tokenizer.revision

document_role: optional; set from the source format and original filenames (document-indexing contract document_role) when the source is chunked from 2026-10-02 (image OCR stage onward); omitted from the payload when unset; never an input of chunk_set_key, chunk_id, content_key or embedding_text
